question: Pointing towards a man, Parkhi said, “He is the brother of my son’s mother”. How that man is related to Parkhi’s husband?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b02115387156e02316bfb1dd95fcf89921e131b2ebba984f145a37f06b22e5d9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3d62ed098673b97815abe580877dcb9acf2c0b6e5e8fb3623aa37efea2d1e40.png] 

Pointing towards a man, Parkhi said, “He is the brother of my son’s mother” → My son's mother is Parkhi herself.

brother of my son’s mother → The man is brother of Parkhi.

Clearly, Husband of Parkhi is brother-in-law of the man.

Hence, ‘**Brother in law**’ is the correct answer.
